claims: The first human moon landing occurred on July 20, 1969.
The first human moon landing occurred during NASA's Apollo 11 mission.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Lunar Module Eagle at 20:17 UTC.
Neil Armstrong took the first step onto the lunar surface roughly six hours later.
The first moon landing occurred at 4:17 p.m. EDT.
The astronauts on the surface during the first moon landing were Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.
The first words spoken on the moon were "That's one small step for [a] man, one giant leap for mankind".
Apollo 17 was the last crewed lunar landing.
Intuitive Machines' Odysseus landed on February 22, 2024.
Intuitive Machines' Odysseus landing marked the first U.S. soft landing in over 50 years.
Firefly Aerospace's Blue Ghost landed on March 2, 2025.
Firefly Aerospace's Blue Ghost was the first commercial lunar landing
